turns.content: For the cylindrical Bessel-function family Y_l^m(theta,phi) with l=0, which values of m are allowed?
Write Y_0^0 as a constant C with pure radial dependence, then normalize it over the unit sphere using sin(theta) dtheta dphi.
Evaluate the normalization integral and solve for the angular eigenvalue C using the standard positive real phase.
Use the angular eigenvalue obtained earlier as the normalization and report Y_0^0 in decimal form, including whether it varies with angle.
Explain whether that normalized lowest member depends on direction.
Report the final normalized spherical harmonic using the standard positive real phase convention.
